name: mu-tax-overview
description: Overview of the Mauritius tax system for the 2026/27 income year: who collects tax, the income year, resident basis, headline personal and company rates, VAT, social contributions, and the main return dates, with links to the detailed skills. Use for a first orientation on Mauritius tax, which taxes apply to a person or business, or which skill in the Mauritius pack to open next. Figures that a detailed skill owns are linked rather than repeated beyond the headline.
